a_baselines_image_level.note: marginal_chance here = median of 5 iid draws from the pooled annotation pmf (ignores the image); uniform = one uniform draw on 1..10; best constants chosen in-sample (optimistic), CIs ignore the selection

ab_alt_definition_median_of_abs_dev.definition: per image median over raters of |annotation - oracle| (midpoint for 4 ratings), then averaged

c_subject_baselines.note: subject-level chance uses one draw from pooled annotation pmf

f_perceptual.method: orb colour = per-channel median sRGB of pixels with alpha==255; sRGB->XYZ (IEC 61966-2-1 matrix) -> CIELAB with D65 white (0.95047,1,1.08883); CIEDE2000 kL=kC=kH=1 (Sharma 2005), verified on 8 Sharma test pairs to 1e-4. dL* = L*(annotated orb) - L*(oracle orb): positive = annotated LIGHTER.
